name: Logan
summary: Logan is a Miami-based yacht/jet charter broker (Status CG, email Logan@statuscg.com) who also handles aviation and takes crypto through that side. He arranged a 68-ft boat rental out of Venetian Marina fuel dock for the owner's July 4th 2026 party, quoted at $8,500 all-in for 13 guests plus $300/head above that, paid via Zelle/Apple Pay deposits ($3,200 then $4,500 of $8,500). As of October 2026 they are working on a hangar/jets video shoot and a jet to London for the owner's artists Max Dean and Luke Dean, with Logan checking max occupancy; he also mentioned a mutual contact 'Los'. Vendor/collaborator rather than a client of any ALTR line.
